summary.zh-Hans: 特贝特生态公园位于雅加达南部，连接原先分开的南北两片公园。Infinity Link Bridge穿行于树木之间，连接两区。
summary.en: Tebet Eco Park in South Jakarta unites formerly separate northern and southern parks. Its Infinity Link Bridge connects the two areas among existing trees.

summary.zh-Hans: MACAN博物馆位于雅加达西部，馆内规划了公共区、展览区和儿童艺术空间。
summary.en: Museum MACAN is in West Jakarta. Its visitor layout includes a public area, an exhibition area and a children’s art space.

summary.zh-Hans: 这种雅加达可见的贝塔维食物用蛋、白糯米、虾米、烤椰蓉和香料制作，在锅中烹至底部干熟。
summary.en: Kerak telor is a Betawi food served in Jakarta, made with egg, white glutinous rice, dried shrimp, toasted coconut and spices, cooked in a pan until the base is set and dry.

summary.zh-Hans: 贝塔维牛肉汤常用牛肉，也可含内脏；汤底可用椰奶、牛奶或两者混合，做法并不只有一种。
summary.en: Soto Betawi commonly contains beef and may include offal. Its broth can use coconut milk, dairy milk or a mixture of both, with more than one preparation in use.
